title: Learn about {theme}
brief: Keep what this Loupist knows about the theme {theme} current. New since the previous run means a dated development that changes the picture: official data, a decision by a company or an authority, research, or material news. Keep one Lens page as a current account of the theme: what drives it, who is exposed to it and what is still open. Retain the Sources it rests on, and report what is new with dates and sources; stay quiet when nothing changed the picture.
